schema_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_sessions (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INT, session_start DATETIME, session_end DATETIME, status VARCHAR(20))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS php_scripts (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, script_name VARCHAR(255), connection_opened BOOLEAN, execution_time INT)
generation_sql: INSERT INTO user_sessions (user_id, session_start, session_end, status) SELECT FLOOR(RAND() * 1000), NOW() - INTERVAL FLOOR(RAND() * 100) MINUTE, NOW(), 'active' FROM generated_numbers WHERE n <= {row_count}
INSERT INTO php_scripts (script_name, connection_opened, execution_time) SELECT CONCAT('script_', n), TRUE, FLOOR(RAND() * 10) FROM generated_numbers WHERE n <= 12

tables.name: user_sessions
tables.purpose: Simulate user sessions to create concurrent database connections.
tables.distribution_notes: Randomized session start and end times to simulate active and inactive sessions.

tables.name: php_scripts
tables.distribution_notes: Each script opens a connection and has a random execution time.

calibration_queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_sessions WHERE status = 'active'
calibration_queries.objective: Verify the number of active sessions matches expectations.
expected_evidence: The count of active sessions aligns with the generated data.

calibration_queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM php_scripts WHERE connection_opened = TRUE
calibration_queries.objective: Ensure all PHP scripts are simulated as opening connections.
expected_evidence: The count of scripts with open connections matches the expected number.
